response.text:
**PDB entry 1M17** — "Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor tyrosine kinase domain with 4-anilinoquinazoline inhibitor erlotinib" (X-ray diffraction, 2.6 Å resolution) — contains the EGFR kinase domain bound to erlotinib.

The chemical component ID for erlotinib in this entry is **AQ4**, defined as [6,7-bis(2-methoxyethoxy)quinazolin-4-yl]-(3-ethynylphenyl)amine (C22H23N3O4, MW 393.4), matching erlotinib's structure (PubChem CID 176870).
